meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清除网文AI写作痕迹让文字回归自然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是网文作者,想避免稿子透出AI腔调。
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI-sounding prose from web novels for natural storytelling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want your prose to sound human.

howto.what: 把用户贴来的网文改写得更自然、更像人写。先扫描标出AI味重的句子(禁用词、工整排比、直接说情绪等),再按“能删就删、删不了才改”原则逐句润色,尽量少改、不动剧情,最后给一份诊断和修改报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-deslop”、“去AI味”、“这篇太AI了”等触发词,或贴出网文要求润色、只要检测时触发。

say.text: 这篇太AI了，帮我改得自然点。
say.note: 会扫描并逐句润色，最后给报告。

say.text: 去AI味：只改表达，别动剧情。
say.note: 遵守删除上限与剧情保护规则。

say.text: 只检测不要改，看看这段AI味重不重。
say.note: 只出问题和等级，不改原文。

howto.what_en: Rewrites user-pasted web-novel text to read less like AI output. Scans for telltale patterns (banned clichés, rigid parallelism, abstract emotion), edits or deletes only what reads artificial, preserves plot/characters, and outputs an edit report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user uses a trigger phrase like /story-deslop or asks to de-AI, polish, or only check a pasted passage's AI flavor.

say_en.text: This passage is too AI-flavored. Make it read more natural.
say_en.note: Runs scan + rewrite and returns an edit report.

say_en.text: De-AI just the wording; don't touch the plot.
say_en.note: Honors deletion caps and plot-protection rules.

say_en.text: Detection only, no edits: how AI-flavored is this?
say_en.note: Outputs level and issues; leaves text unchanged.
